Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Planning Commission meetings are welcomed and
appreciated. Community engagement provides the Planning Commission with valuable information. Regular
Meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any
person with a disability who requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk’s Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

The Council Chambers will be open to the public at 6:00 p.m. Materials related to an item on this agenda,
submitted to the Planning Commission after distribution of the agenda packet, are available for public
inspection at the meeting or in the Community Development Department during normal business hours.

  still needed to extend the line from Claremont to Montclair.

  The Commissioners had questions regarding traffic signal timing, the
  testing phase of the project, and additional funding for the extension to

 Planning Commission Minutes

 Memorandum
CITY OF LA VERNE
Community Development Department
DATE:  April 12, 2023
TO:  Planning Commission
FROM:  Gabriel Rivera, Assistant Planner
SUBJECT:  Public Hearing for Draft Accessory Dwelling Unit Ordinance

While notices of public hearing before the Planning Commission for this meeting (April 12,
2023) were published in the Daily Bulletin for both the draft Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU)
and SB 9 ordinances, the notice for the draft ADU ordinance was not posted at City Hall
nor on the website at least 10 days before the hearing date. As such, the hearing for the
ADU ordinance was not fully noticed as required by state law. But as it was published in
the newspaper, we are required to at least open and then continue the hearing to allow
additional noticing.

As a result, staff is recommending that the public hearing for the draft ADU ordinance be
opened and then immediately continued to the next Planning Commission meeting to be
held on Wednesday April 26, 2023 at 6:30 p.m. The new meeting date for the continued
public hearing will then be posted at least 10 days prior to that meeting at City Hall and the
City’s website.
 Memorandum
CITY OF LA VERNE
Community Development Department
DATE:  April 12, 2023
TO:  Planning Commission
FROM:  Parker Stringfellow, Assistant Planner
SUBJECT:  Continuation of Draft SB 9 Ordinance, Resolution No. 1302

As the Planning Commission is aware, staff is recommending that the public hearing for
the draft Accessory Dwelling Unit Ordinance be opened and then continued to April 26,
2023. Due to the close association of the draft SB 9 ordinance to the proposed ADU
ordinance, staff believes it would be best to also open and continue the public hearing for
the Draft SB 9 Ordinance to be able to present and review both items during the same
meeting.

Staff formally recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing for the
proposed draft SB 9 ordinance, Resolution No. 1302, and immediately continue the item to
a Planning Commission meeting on April 26th, 2023.
 Memorandum
CITY OF LA VERNE
Community Development Department
DATE:  April 12, 2023
TO:  Planning Commission
FROM:  Gabriel Rivera, Assistant Planner
SUBJECT: Case No. 15-23VAR – 1122 Sandhurst Ln.

The applicant for Case Number 15-23VAR failed to provide the necessary information to
complete the application for the Development Review Committee (DRC) to review the
project and forward a recommendation for the Planning Commission.

As staff had already submitted the notice of public hearing to the Daily Bulletin to be
published on March 31, 2023, and directly mailed to all owners within 300’ of the property
and posted at City Hall and the City’s website at the same time, the public hearing for this
item has already been properly noticed. Without the recommendation of the DRC,
however, staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing for
Case No.15-23VAR and immediately continue the item to the next regularly scheduled
Planning Commission meeting on Wednesday, May 10, 2023, so that the DRC may make
a recommendation at their May 2, 2023 meeting.
